title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Compromise Offers Signed by the Debtor
content:
## Situation of use and capability

A compromise offer on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is signed by the debtor, goes in with the debtor's Financial Status Report attached, and puts forward the lump sum VA measures against what it can recover from the debtor over time. A debtor whose debt is not being collected by withholding from VA benefit payments is not held to the reduced-withholding condition stated next; every other condition on taking an offer still applies to that debtor.

For a debtor whose VA benefit payments are being withheld for the debt, the lump sum a compromise offer puts forward is worked out only after the debt carries an approved reduced monthly withholding from the debtor's benefit payments.

In the same terms: where benefit payments are being withheld for the debt, the lump sum is set only once an approved reduced monthly withholding from those payments stands on the debt.

The submission tool records one compromise offer on one debt, received today by phone and pending a decision, stating the lump sum offered and whether a Financial Status Report is attached. The debt's balance and status are not changed by the call.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `submit_compromise_offer_8c2d0269`. It belongs to the debtor: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves signs and submits the offer during the call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `debt_id` | The reference number of the VA debt the offer is made on, as shown on the debt record returned by the debt lookup for this debtor | Identifier text |
| `requested_amount` | The lump sum offered, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, stored rounded half-to-even to the cent; passed at cent precision |
| `fsr_submitted` | Whether a Financial Status Report accompanies the offer | `true` when the debtor attaches a signed Financial Status Report to this offer; `false` when the offer goes in without one |
| `received_within_hold_window` | Whether today falls inside the debt's collection-hold window counted from its notice date | `true` when today is within that window; `false` when today is after that window has closed |

## Return

A successful call returns `request_id` (reference number of the offer; its presence means the offer is on file), `debt_id`, `request_kind` (always "compromise"), `received_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `requested_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `fsr_submitted` (boolean) and `decision_outcome` (always "pending").
